description: This file defines the OrderNumberGenerator interface which is intended to be implemented by classes that generate order numbers within the OpenMRS system. It specifies a single method for generating new, unique order numbers, emphasizing thread safety and use in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: OrderNumberGenerator
classes.description: An interface for classes responsible for generating new order numbers within the system.

methods.name: getNewOrderNumber
methods.description: Generate a new order number using the provided OrderContext. Must be thread-safe and produce unique results when called multiple times without saving orders.
